name: Blue Luma
_why_template: Boo, as the yellow Luma (0x84) now is: it was Extra Innings' Luma (stock slot 0x4B, Boo's layout). Boo's files 3-14, size, hitbox and per-character floats equal what that Luma gave, and Boo's hand-node pair is the (2, 3) charbuild 9a patched it to. The rows that differ are in table_rows
_why_scale: 0.63x Mario (Nick: the Lumas are slightly too small at 0.77)
_why_hitting_ability: Nick: Star Get is a hitting ability (the batter star when they come up to bat, batter_star.py): the star swing row with the bat icon (star_move_labels.py). Their item row is Star Bit Storm.

bat._why: Extra Innings' yellow Luma bat in the Luma's color: python scripts/bat_recolors.py luma-blue

_why_balance: git-8a's balance pass (Nick): own stats; chemistry starts neutral (not the template's). Pull Star Luma; blue friends; Lumas together.
_why_batting_arm: Right-handed batter (Luma's template bats left, Boo's layout: the bat sat in his left hand, hidden behind his body from the batting camera; Nick: wrong hand)
_why_model: Our Galaxy Luma (Tico rip) over Boo's layout, recoloured: python scripts/luma_colors.py. File 1 = the high block, as EI's Luma dir ships (Boo's own file 1 would be Boo's low model). Files 6-14: its own animation banks, Boo's with the hover bob flattened and the root held 0.10 lower (scripts/flatten_hover.py -> models/work/luma-own/anim): on Boo's own banks the Luma floated up to 0.5 off the ground at the top of every bob and sank 0.23 into it in the fielding crouch.
_why_table_rows: The yellow Luma's rows (today: copied from Extra Innings' Luma 0x4B, catch radii then set by table_stats) where they differ from Boo's: TABLES name -> whole row, hex. Inert until charbuild reads "table_rows" (docs/stock-slot-migration.md)
_why_strike_zone: python scripts/strike_zones.py --write: Boo's zone sits 53% of the way up its body in the batting stance (0.950 on 0.33..1.51); this body is 0.02..1.35, so 0.720 (the template's 0.950 would sit at 70%). World height = this x sizescale x scale
